{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
[[File:BibFortuna-USCVV.png|thumb|right|220px|[[Bib Fortuna]] wore a robe made of Jalavash worm silk.]]
'''Jalavash worm silk''' was a material produced by the [[Jalavash worm]]. It was woven into traditional [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leki]] [[Robe/Legends|robes]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|2|136|jalavash worm}}</ref>
